idea-plugin.name: ktrs
idea-plugin.description:
ktlint diagnostics, quick fixes and ktfmt or ktlint formatting for Kotlin, from ktrs's native language server (ktrs lsp). No JVM, a few milliseconds per file.

  • Diagnostics: ktlint violations as you type, with the rule id.
  • Quick fixes: fix one violation, fix all autocorrectable ones, suppress a rule on the line or in the file.
  • Formatting: Reformat Code with ktfmt or ktlint's --format.
  • Build-aware: reads the ktfmt/ktlint setup from Gradle or Maven.

Runs on IntelliJ's LSP client (IntelliJ IDEA 2025.3+, Android Studio 2026.2+) or, in IDEs without it, on LSP4IJ. Settings: Settings | Tools | ktrs.
